The company’s valuation could rise to Rs 4,000-4,500 crore from Rs 2,500 crore, driven by rapid topline growth at the company founded by Ankit Chona of the family behind Havmor ice creams.

Private equity firms General Atlantic and ChrysCapital are in discussions with Hocco Ice Cream to invest Rs 300-400 crore in the new-age direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand, according to three people aware of these talks.
